stem.text: $\text{AgNO}_3\text{(aq)}$ is added to a solution of a halide ion, $\text{X}^{-}\text{(aq)}$, and aqueous ammonia is then added.
The ionic equations for the two reactions that occur are shown.

A.text: The position of equilibrium 1 lies to the left when $\text{X}^{-} = \text{I}^{-}$.

B.text: Increasing the concentration of ammonia causes the position of equilibrium 1 to move to the left.

C.text: $K_\text{c}$ for equilibrium 2 is larger when $\text{X}^{-} = \text{Cl}^{-}$ than when $\text{X}^{-} = \text{I}^{-}$.
